page.overview:
Who is Warrior Prophet?

The is an Aztec warrior that lived in South America many years before the events of the Street Fighter series.

The Warrior Prophet is a man with long hair and many scars. He wears golden ornaments, the ones in his arms and legs and his helmet being shaped like a snake. He has knives made with bones and tusks.

During sunset, the Warrior Prophet is seen monologuing in a place called "Ancient Altar". He forsees that during the next 'Hour of Battle', Necalli will consume the souls of three warriors. When he ends talking, it is revealed that Necalli has come to devour the soul of the Warrior Prophet, who takes solace in knowing that only the strongest warriors witness Necalli. After a short battle, the Warrior Prophet is defeated and consumed by Necalli. However, upon consuming the Warrior Prophet, Necalli's appearance changes from his original form to a much more human-looking one, with the scars and markings of the Warrior Prophet transferring to him.
